question: Estimate the number of weddings on a single most-auspicious 'muhurta' day in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single most-auspicious day (Vivah muhurta in November or December)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Number of major muhurta days in this period: ~12-15 days (panchang).

Number of major muhurta days in this period

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3-5 lakh weddings on single most-auspicious day in India.

calculationFlow: Of these, in Nov-Dec muhurta cluster: ~30-35% = ~3.5-4M.
Top 3 most-auspicious days concentrate ~40% of muhurta-cluster weddings: 1.5M / 3 = ~5 lakh weddings on a single peak muhurta day.
Round: ~3-5 lakh weddings on single most-auspicious day in India.
